title: Server-declared notification stream error recovery

behavior.serverErrorFrame: The web client consumes the existing notification-error SSE event and closes only the failed EventSource before retrying.
behavior.retryHint: Numeric retryAfterMs hints are rounded and clamped to the existing 1-30 second safety window; malformed or missing hints use bounded attempt backoff.
behavior.duplicateTimerSafety: The active stream reference and one retry timer prevent a server error frame followed by onerror from scheduling duplicate reconnects.
behavior.preserved: The 60-second polling fallback, tenant/role scope, cursor/count snapshots, category filtering, preferences, read actions, focus containment, scroll isolation and tenant-safe deep links remain unchanged.

localVerification.verifierPortNote: The project Compose stack was stopped without deleting containers or volumes for the owned fixture run, then started again and health-checked. The verifier now accepts a bounded --smtp-port override; CI defaults remain unchanged.
